name: badge
title: Badge
description: A short label for a state or a kind in 12px capitals, square: the quiet fill (the site's chosen filter chip), the plate, a hairline, or a red wash. A small white or mid dot can lead it.
use_for: A filter's chosen option, a role's department, a state beside a title.
never: A color as the badge's fill or dot: the brand is monochrome
Color alone for the meaning: the word says it
source: shadcn's badge, drawn in the Agencidev tokens (brand/tokens.css, from the site's app/globals.css and components/page-tokens.ts): the near-black canvas and white ink, the greys, square corners with the 4px plate, ABC Diatype and Agencidev Sans, color changes on hover and press only.
